subject: general
question: As of July 2025, which of the following is NOT a classical language?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hindi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• As of **July 2025**, the Government of India has designated **11 languages** as **Classical Languages**. These include **Tamil**, **Sanskrit**, **Kannada**, **Telugu**, **Malayalam**, **Odia**, and the five added in **October 2024**: **Marathi**, **Pali**, **Prakrit**, **Assamese**, and **Bengali**.&
